Name: Auto Swap Tool - Return to Last Tool After Using Items
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Auto Swap Back[/center][/size][/b][center]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads[/url][/center]


Auto Swap Back is a quality-of-life mod that automatically switches your active slot back to your primary tool after you use a consumable item. It is designed to make

farming, mining, and combat smoother by removing the need to manually scroll back to your pickaxe or sword.
[line]
[b]How It Works: Please keep items and tools on the same row of tool bar
[/b]
When you use specific items, the mod detects the change and swaps your hand back to the tool you were holding previously (or the tool in the slot you switched from).

[list]
[*]Works with Seeds, Food, and Bombs.
[*]Includes logic for "inedible" items like Sap or Void Mayonnaise.
[*]Supports modded items.
[/list]
[center][youtube]FMNSMi1xT_M[/youtube][/center][line]
[b]Configuration
[/b]
You can configure the behavior for each item category separately using Generic Mod Config Menu.

[list]
[*][b]Used Once:[/b] Swaps back immediately after using one item. Best for eating food or placing a single bomb.
[*][b]Depleted:[/b] Swaps back only when the stack reaches zero. Best for planting seeds.
[*][b]Disabled:[/b] The mod will not act on this category.
[/list][b]Default Settings:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Seeds: Depleted
[*]Food: Used Once
[*]Bombs: Used Once
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40815/40815-1767477690-1755665085.png[/img]﻿[line]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for settings).
[*]Download the mod files.
[*]Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[*]Launch the game.
[/list]
